# AgenticMyze

> AgenticMyze's main product is the AI Business & Client Acquisition Program: pain-point niche selection, Grand Slam Offers, AI systems, funnel building, retention pricing, acquisition systems, and closing. n8n is a supporting skill. Starter includes 20 recorded lectures without a client guarantee; Professional guarantees 1 client in 45 days; Elite guarantees 2 clients in 45 days. Professional and Elite include a refund guarantee if results do not come. All tiers include 20+ results and testimonials access.
